Google Releases Open-Source Elephant Goldfish Model for AI Software Design

03 Nov 2026, 12:36 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: github.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysAn open-source plugin called the Elephant Goldfish Model (EGM) has been made available to help software engineering teams design and review code using AI agents. Introduction to Elephant Goldfish Model

An open-source plugin called the Elephant Goldfish Model (EGM) has been made available to help software engineering teams design and review code using AI agents. According to project documentation, the framework aims to structure how AI assists in drafting software specifications and stress-testing them before implementation.

Core Workflow and Dual-Agent Roles

The framework divides the software design process into two distinct phases utilizing different agent contexts:

  • Elephant: This component is designed to hold project context and assist developers in drafting the initial technical specification.
  • Goldfish: This component uses zero-context subagents to review the draft and referenced source material without prior conversational baggage, aiming to uncover unstated assumptions and blind spots.

Developers retain ultimate responsibility for architectural trade-offs and must explicitly approve the specification before any coding begins.

Practical Application and Guidelines

Project guidelines suggest applying the workflow when tackling features that require upfront design decisions, such as handling webhook delivery failures or duplicate events. For minor bug fixes, the documentation recommends sticking to standard coding workflows.

  • Installation: Available for supported environments including Antigravity App, IDE extensions, Claude Cowork, and ChatGPT Work.
  • Execution: Commands may require specific prefixes depending on the CLI version or coding agent used.
  • Limitations: Reviews require environments capable of creating fresh subagent contexts. The system does not replace human judgment or automated testing.

How to Verify and Learn More

Users interested in examining the codebase, licensing details (Apache 2.0), or contribution guidelines can access the official GitHub repository hosted under google/elephant-goldfish-model. The repository also includes links to documentation, setup guides, and the original conceptual essay by Dave Rensin. It is important to note that the project documentation explicitly states this is not an officially supported Google product.
